site.name: audius-studio
site.description: The Audius Studio browser DAW (audius-studio.online) driven like an API, in the style of api-anything: every call returns {ok, class, tier, data, ms}. File operations run on the local server (tier 1); session operations run inside a connected DAW browser tab (tier 3) through the WebSocket bridge, so the real Web Audio engine executes them. Start the server with `npm start`, keep one DAW tab open, then call: POST /api/call {"op":"getClips"}.

operations.name: getHealth
operations.description: Server and API health: app name, platform, node version, api version, operation count and how many DAW tabs are connected.

operations.name: listSessions
operations.description: The DAW browser tabs currently connected to the bridge. Page operations run in the newest session; pass session=<id> to /api/call to target one.

operations.name: listProjectFiles
operations.description: Saved .dawproj.json project files on the server disk, newest first: fileName, name, size, updatedAt.

operations.name: getProjectFile
operations.description: One saved .dawproj.json project file from the server disk, parsed as JSON.

params.name: name
params.description: Project name (or file name) without needing the .dawproj.json suffix.

operations.name: putProjectFile
operations.description: Write a .dawproj.json project file to the server disk without a browser session. The project object needs at least tracks[] and clips[]; loadProject can then open it in a DAW tab.

params.name: name
params.description: Project name; stored as <name>.dawproj.json.

params.name: project
params.description: Project payload: {name?, bpm?, masterVolumeDb?, loopEnabled?, loopStartBeat?, loopEndBeat?, metronome?, markers?, tracks[], clips[], patterns?}.

operations.name: deleteProjectFile
operations.description: Delete a saved .dawproj.json project file from the server disk.

params.name: name
params.description: Project name or file name.

operations.name: listExports
operations.description: WAV files rendered by exportWav, newest first: name, url, bytes, updatedAt. Fetch a url to download the audio.

operations.name: deleteExport
operations.description: Delete one rendered WAV file from the exports folder.

params.name: name
params.description: File name from listExports.

operations.name: listImports
operations.description: Audio files uploaded to the server's import inbox (POST /api/imports/upload), ready for importAudio with url=/api/imports/<name>.

operations.name: getSession
operations.description: The full live session: project (name, bpm, master, loop, metronome, markers, tracks, clips), transport position, UI state (tool, snap, selection), the stem/asset pool and undo/redo depths.

operations.name: getTransport
operations.description: Transport state: playing, beat, bar, seconds, bpm, loop and metronome flags.

operations.name: getTracks
operations.description: Every playlist track with its mixer state (volumeDb, pan, muted, solo, 3-band EQ) and clip count.

operations.name: getClips
operations.description: Playlist clips (segments) with startBeat, durationBeats, endBeat, sourceOffsetSec, gainDb, pitchSemitones, pan, fades, reverse and muted. Filter by trackId or clipIds.

params.name: trackId
params.description: Only clips on this track.

params.name: clipIds
params.description: Only these clip ids.

operations.name: getAssets
operations.description: The stem/asset pool: every decoded audio buffer with id, name, color, durationSec, sampleRate and channel count.

operations.name: getMarkers
operations.description: Arrangement markers on the ruler: id, beat, name, color.

operations.name: getMeters
operations.description: Live level meters: master left/right and per-track peak levels (0..1).

operations.name: listProjects
operations.description: Saved projects visible to the DAW tab, merged from browser localStorage and the server disk: name, source, updatedAt.

operations.name: newSession
operations.description: Replace the live session with a fresh empty one: one track, no clips, no markers. Undoable.

params.name: name
params.description: Session name.

params.name: bpm
params.description: Tempo, clamped 40-260.

operations.name: loadDemo
operations.description: Restore the built-in demo session "Untitled" (138 BPM, 34 bars, 5 synthesized stems). Undoable.

operations.name: saveProject
operations.description: Save the live session to browser localStorage and to the server disk as <name>.dawproj.json (no file download is triggered).

params.name: name
params.description: Rename the project before saving; defaults to the current name.

operations.name: loadProject
operations.description: Open a saved project in the live session, by name (localStorage first, then server disk) or by passing a full project payload. Undoable.

params.name: name
params.description: Saved project name.

params.name: project
params.description: A .dawproj.json payload to load directly (needs tracks[] and clips[]).

operations.name: setProjectInfo
operations.description: Change top-level session settings: name, bpm (40-260), masterVolumeDb (-36..6), metronome, loopEnabled, loopStartBeat, loopEndBeat.

operations.name: undo
operations.description: Undo the last session edit (same history the Ctrl+Z key uses).

operations.name: redo
operations.description: Redo the last undone session edit.

operations.name: play
operations.description: Start playback of the arrangement (SONG mode), optionally from a beat. Mirrors the Play button.

params.name: fromBeat
params.description: Start position in beats; defaults to the current playhead.

operations.name: pause
operations.description: Pause playback, keeping the playhead position.

operations.name: stop
operations.description: Stop playback and return the playhead to the loop start (or bar 1).

operations.name: seek
operations.description: Move the playhead. Pass exactly one of beat, bar (1-based, 4 beats) or seconds.

operations.name: setTempo
operations.description: Set the project tempo in BPM, clamped 40-260 like the tempo box.

operations.name: setLoop
operations.description: Set the loop region and/or toggle looping: enabled, startBeat, endBeat.

operations.name: setMetronome
operations.description: Turn the metronome click on or off.

operations.name: addTrack
operations.description: Add a playlist track (like the + Track button), optionally named and colored.

operations.name: removeTrack
operations.description: Delete a track and all of its clips. The last remaining track is cleared instead of deleted, matching the UI.

operations.name: renameTrack
operations.description: Rename a track.

operations.name: setTrackMix
operations.description: Per-track mixer strip: volumeDb (-36..6), pan (-1..1), muted, solo and the 3-band EQ (eqLowDb shelf 120 Hz, eqMidDb peak 1.1 kHz, eqHighDb shelf 6.5 kHz, each -15..15).

operations.name: selectTrack
operations.description: Select a track (drives the track inspector and header highlight).

operations.name: importAudio
operations.description: Decode audio into the stem pool and (by default) drop it on the playlist as a new clip on a new track. Pass bytes as base64 (data URLs accepted) or a url the DAW tab can fetch (e.g. /api/imports/<file> after uploading with POST /api/imports/upload). WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG/M4A — anything the browser can decode.

params.name: name
params.description: Asset name; defaults to the url file name or "imported-audio".

params.name: base64
params.description: Audio file bytes, base64-encoded.

params.name: url
params.description: URL to fetch the audio from (same-origin paths like /api/imports/kick.wav work best).

params.name: trackId
params.description: Place the clip on this track; defaults to a new track.

params.name: startBeat
params.description: Where the clip starts; defaults to the playhead.

params.name: addClip
params.description: false = keep it in the stem pool only, without a playlist clip.

operations.name: removeAsset
operations.description: Delete a stem/asset from the pool and every clip that uses it.

operations.name: addClip
operations.description: Put a clip of a pooled asset on the playlist (like dragging the stem onto a track).

params.name: trackId
params.description: Defaults to the selected track, else the first track.

params.name: startBeat
params.description: Defaults to the playhead.

params.name: durationBeats
params.description: Trim the clip to this length (min 0.125); defaults to the asset's full length.

operations.name: selectClips
operations.description: Set the playlist selection: pass clipIds, or trackId to select a whole lane, or all=true for everything. Most clip operations default to this selection.

operations.name: moveClips
operations.description: Move clips in time and/or across tracks. Relative: deltaBeats, deltaTracks. Absolute: startBeat (single clip, or the whole group keeping its offsets) and/or trackId. Targets: clipIds, else the current selection.

operations.name: trimClips
operations.description: Non-destructive trim: set a new startBeat and/or endBeat (or durationBeats). Trimming the start advances sourceOffsetSec so the audio stays aligned, like dragging the clip edge.

operations.name: splitClips
operations.description: Razor-slice clips at one beat (grid-snapped like the Cut tool). Without clipIds, every clip crossing atBeat is split.

operations.name: splitAtPlayhead
operations.description: The K key as an operation: split the selected clips (or every clip when nothing is selected) at the playhead.

operations.name: chopClips
operations.description: One-click chop: slice targets into uniform segments every everyBeats, or by preset (1beat, 1bar, halfbar, eighth), or by detected drum/note transients with transients=true.

params.name: clipIds
params.description: Defaults to the current selection.

params.name: everyBeats
params.description: Uniform slice length in beats (> 0.0625).

params.name: transients
params.description: true = Auto-Slice Hits instead of a uniform grid.

operations.name: duplicateClips
operations.description: Ctrl+D as an operation: copy the target clips to right after their span.

operations.name: reverseClips
operations.description: R as an operation: toggle reverse playback on the target clips.

operations.name: muteClips
operations.description: Mute or unmute playlist segments (the T tool). Omit muted to toggle.

operations.name: deleteClips
operations.description: Delete the target clips from the playlist.

operations.name: slipClips
operations.description: Slip audio inside segment boundaries (the S tool): shift sourceOffsetSec by deltaSec, or by deltaBeats of timeline time, without moving the clip.

operations.name: setClipParams
operations.description: The clip inspector as an operation: gainDb (-24..12), pitchSemitones (-12..12, changes speed too), pan (-1..1), fadeInBeats, fadeOutBeats, reverse, muted, color, name, playbackRate (0.25..4).

operations.name: clearPlaylist
operations.description: Remove every clip from the playlist, keeping tracks and the stem pool.

operations.name: addMarker
operations.description: Add an arrangement marker on the ruler.

operations.name: removeMarker
operations.description: Delete an arrangement marker by id (getMarkers lists them).

operations.name: exportWav
operations.description: Render the arrangement offline (faster than realtime) to WAV and store it on the server: mode master (stereo mixdown) or stems (one file per unmuted track with clips); 16/24/32-bit; 44.1/48 kHz; the full song or the loop region. Returns [{name, url, bytes, durationSec}] — fetch a url to download the audio.

params.name: filename
params.description: File name prefix; defaults to the project name.

operations.name: setTool
operations.description: Switch the active playlist tool: draw, paint, slice, slip, mute, select, delete or pan (same as the P/C/S/T/E keys).

params.name: tool
params.hint: draw, paint, slice, slip, mute, select, delete or pan
